title: A numeric criterion's test must not lower its bar to fit a slow machine
rule: When a criterion states a number (fps, ms, MB), assert that literal number. If a machine cannot measure it (a CI runner whose idle frame rate is under the target), call test.skip with a reason, so the report says it was not measured. Never derive the bar from the machine's own speed: a green test must mean the number was met.
rationale: E41.1 (#447): `fps >= min(55, idle - 5)` set the bar at 25 on the macOS runner, so a 30 fps slider was green against a criterion of 55.
